task: V44 cover-door repair and new whole-book consistency audit
scope_statement: Fresh individual visual review of all 34 inherited book entries, plus an early look at the first repaired V44 doorway. This is not final V44 export acceptance. No old visual PASS was inherited.
prior_miss_acknowledgment: The earlier scoped V43 satisfaction failed to identify the structurally incomplete cover doorway. That satisfaction does not establish correctness of the door. The owner's rejection is correct, and this review reopens that feature explicitly.

authority.applicability: Static picture-book source-preserving review. Existing identity anchors and book design language apply. No game behavior, cinematic delivery or MA game-finding closure is claimed.
authority.implementation_limit: Repair existing scenes locally from approved source art; preserve character identity, staging, action and manuscript. No full-scene redraw, new narrative event or generic style homogenization is recommended.

method.proof_source: V43 reading cover and exact V42 body PNGs, each opened individually. Repeated character/location/action features compared across the sequence.

actual_delivery_check.method: PDFium actual PDF 1.5x RGB rendering, no JPEG normalization

additional_visual_checks: Fountain head crops for entries11/15/16 compared side by side in memory.
First repaired V44 doorway enlarged in memory to inspect leaves, hinges, handles, threshold and Puff occlusion.
Original canonical Roshan/Daddy/Rumi/Eagle/little-puff/Lamma/Grand-Puff identity images opened read-only.
method.honest_limit: This on-screen audit is evidence of the observations below, not a guarantee that no microscopic error exists and not a physical trim, binding or child-readability test. The final V44 PDF/door proof is still required.

findings.title: Cover has only one complete door leaf and incomplete hinge structure
findings.observation: The V43 cover shows a complete decorated right shell leaf, but the opposite side reads as an opening/jamb without its matching complete leaf/outer hinge assembly. This is a real construction omission, not simply natural occlusion.
findings.permitted_repair: Bounded doorway-only source-led repair with two coherent shell leaves, complete outer hinge assemblies and free-edge handles. Keep Puff and all other figures/columns/source scene intact.
findings.early_repair_read: First V44 repaired proof has two readable leaves, four outer hinge assemblies and inner hardware. Threshold and source joins look coherent at the enlarged view; Puff's partial ear/body occlusion is natural. Not yet a final export verdict.

findings.title: New left door tip overlaps the title
findings.observation: On the first repaired proof, the new left leaf's pointed gold top passes behind the final letters of 'Bunnies', approximately x1274–1314,y174–228 at 1512×1080. The mechanism is repaired but creates a title/architecture collision.
findings.permitted_repair: Keep a visible gap between actual title ink and the complete door silhouette. Parent proposes shifting both existing title lines left as one block, retaining exact wording/font sizes/baselines/line breaks. Review that result rather than accepting the current collision.

findings.title: Opening window shows a different setting from the selected full Sky Lagoon arrival
findings.observation: Story1 presents Pearl Castle on a small tropical ocean island, with surrounding islands, palms, sea horizon and a short shore bridge. Story2's owner-selected full Sky Lagoon has a mountain/cloud landscape, two water areas, playground, landing path and the route uphill to the castle. The camera angle alone does not establish a continuous geography between these visibly different source settings.
findings.boundary: This is an inherited source mismatch; it is not a new V44 door defect and does not justify inventing another whole scene. The four-tower castle and stained-glass identity agree, while surrounding geography does not.
findings.permitted_repair: If corrected in this consistency pass, replace only the scenery visible through the existing porthole using the established full Sky Lagoon/castle source composition. Preserve Roshan, plane/window frame, reflections, caption and restored Roshan stained glass. Otherwise keep this mismatch explicitly open; do not label whole-book scenery fully consistent.

findings.title: Seahorse fountain's forehead changes between views
findings.observation: Entry11 has a smooth lavender forehead/small ridge beads without a projecting cone. Entry15 has a large gold conical horn on the forehead, and entry16 has a much smaller gold nub. The large horn changes the silhouette and is not explained by the unblocking action. Opposite profile and scale account for some detail visibility but do not fully explain a central forward horn disappearing.
findings.permitted_repair: Choose the established seahorse prop authority and make only the forehead/horn detail consistent using existing source reuse or a bounded local repair. Retain cup/spout/water action, Roshan, pool layout and existing source staging. Do not redraw the room or treat all scale/perspective differences as defects.

findings.title: Different existing source drawing finishes remain visible
findings.observation: Full scenes tend to be glossy and richly painted; Eagle21 and some spot illustrations have finer/darker contour drawing and flatter/more muted fills. Identity colours, costume parts, facial roles and required anatomy remain readable. These differences alone do not establish a character redesign.
findings.decision: Do not generate replacement characters merely to homogenize accepted source finishes. Preserve the source-led book method. No numeric style score or claim of perfect uniformity.
